verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a conventional flag-driven CLI (`skills add`, `use`, `find`, `update`, `remove`, `init`) and a keyword search. Nothing shows the product itself accepting natural-language commands. `skills use ... | claude` only pipes a generated skill prompt into an external agent, which is not natural-language operation of skills.sh. Skills being interpreted by agents is a feature of those agents, not a way to drive this product.
